title: Reposition Storefront as Multi-Disciplinary Design, Fabrication, and Framing Studio Across 6 Core Service Verticals
description: Per user explicit instruction, transformed Frame Cottage from a consumer-only retail framing shop into a multi-disciplinary design, fabrication, and framing studio delivering end-to-end spatial, industrial, and aesthetic solutions for B2C, B2B, and public sector clients across 6 exact service verticals: 1. Retail & Standard Framing (B2C), 2. Bespoke Art & Custom Framing (B2C/B2B), 3. Spatial Design & Signage (B2B), 4. Industrial Fabrication & CNC Metalworks (Commercial), 5. Custom Gifting & Mementos (Corporate), and 6. Government & Civic Projects (Public Sector). Created `lib/constants/verticals.ts` with comprehensive data models, deliverables, technical specs, icons, audience badges, and sub-capabilities. Updated site announcement bar, navigation headers, mega-menu with 6-vertical taxonomy and RFQ CTA box, mobile navigation drawer with expandable vertical accordions, hero carousel with 3 multi-disciplinary studio lifestyle slides, category discovery swatches and pills with client audience badges, studio trust bar with 4 precision engineering and tender-compliance pillars, curated projects grid across all 6 verticals, featured products carousel showcasing architectural wayfinding, CNC laser-cut plaques, perforated metal facades, and crystal awards alongside bespoke frames, 4-stage turnkey studio workflow, multi-disciplinary client case studies (Tech Enterprise HQ, Collector Residence, Municipal City Hall), comprehensive studio FAQ, reorganized 4-column studio footer, and updated root metadata.
